title: Yellow Turmeric Greek Feta Saganaki
description: A creamy and aromatic Greek dish featuring turmeric and feta cheese, cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron, perfect for a crowd. This recipe is shojin-friendly and served in a saganaki form.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add olive oil to the cauldron and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add turmeric powder and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Crumble the feta cheese into the cauldron and stir to combine with the turmeric mixture.
Squeeze lemon juice over the feta mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and serve the saganaki hot.
